data.name: Warding Talisman [Abjuration]
data.description: The implement wards against adverse effects. Whoever wears (or holds, for bells) the implement gains a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws for every 2 points of mental focus invested in the implement (+%1), to a maximum bonus of +%2.|OccultistWardingTalisman|1+OccultistLVL/4
